question: Which of the following is NOT a type of mosquito?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Limulus.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Limulus is NOT a type of mosquito.**
 
• It is also known as the** king crab or horseshoe crab.**
 
• It belongs to the phylum** "Arthropoda"**.
 
• It has remained unchanged for the last **190 million** thereby it is considered a living fossil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc03a97390f08ad0fe3cd4a4744487540709641b5aa453f5845cf963a473f7f5.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anopheles:**

 
 
• ​The female Anopheles mosquito is the vector of malaria.
 
• Malaria is caused by the parasite Plasmodium.
 
• It affects red blood cells and the liver.
 
 
 
• **Culex:**
 
 
• It is a genus of mosquitoes, several species of which serve as vectors of one or more important diseases of birds, humans, and other animals.
 
• The diseases they vector include arbovirus infections such as West Nile virus, Japanese encephalitis, St. Louis encephalitis, and Filariasis.
 
 
 
• **Female Aedes:**
 
 
• It is mosquitos are dengue virus carriers.
 
• Dengue mosquitos typically bite during the day and can be found almost anywhere. These mosquitos are most active in the early morning and late evening.
 
• There is no specific medicine or vaccine to treat dengue fever. People who have dengue fever should rest and drink plenty of fluids.
